body:
## Objective
Fix Astro deprecation warning: define `projects` collection in content.config.ts, delete stray test collection.

## Context
Astro warns: "Auto-generating collections for folders in src/content/ that are not defined as collections. This is deprecated." Collections `projects` and `test` are auto-generated but not defined in `src/content.config.ts`. Only `blog` is defined.

## Files
- `src/content.config.ts` (edit)
- `src/content/test/test.mdx` (delete)
- `src/content/test/` (delete directory if empty after)

## Action Steps

### 1. Delete stray test collection
```bash
rm -rf src/content/test
```
The `test.mdx` file is just a test artifact ("Test collection to verify detection"). Not referenced anywhere. Delete the entire `src/content/test/` directory.

Verify no references:
```bash
rg -n "content/test\|getCollection..test.\|'test'" src/ --type ts --type astro
```

### 2. Define projects collection in content.config.ts
Current file only defines `blogCollection`. Add a `projectsCollection` with schema matching the frontmatter in `src/content/projects/*.mdx` files.

Project frontmatter fields (from reading the .mdx files):
- `id`: string (required) — e.g. "1", "2"
- `title`: string (required)
- `description`: string (required)
- `category`: string (required) — e.g. "software", "site"
- `image`: string (required) — URL
- `technologies`: array of strings (required)
- `link`: string (required) — URL
- `featured`: boolean (required)
- `github`: string (optional) — URL, some projects have it

Add to content.config.ts:
```typescript
import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content';

const blogCollection = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    excerpt: z.string(),
    date: z.coerce.date(),
    tags: z.array(z.string()),
    updatedDate: z.coerce.date().optional(),
    image: z.string().optional(),
    imageAlt: z.string().optional(),
    seoTitle: z.string().optional(),
    seoDescription: z.string().optional(),
    draft: z.boolean().optional(),
  }),
});

const projectsCollection = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    title: z.string(),
    description: z.string(),
    category: z.string(),
    image: z.string(),
    technologies: z.array(z.string()),
    link: z.string().url(),
    featured: z.boolean(),
    github: z.string().url().optional(),
  }),
});

export const collections = {
  blog: blogCollection,
  projects: projectsCollection,
};
```

NOTE: Check ALL project .mdx files first to verify which fields are optional vs required. Some projects may not have `github`. Some may not have `featured`. Read 2-3 more project files to confirm before finalizing schema. If any required field is missing from some files, make it optional.

### 3. Verify
```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx astro build
```
Confirm: no more "Auto-generating collections" warning, build passes, 40 pages still build.

## Constraints
- Only edit `src/content.config.ts` and delete `src/content/test/`
- Do NOT touch any project .mdx files or blog .mdx files
- Schema must match existing frontmatter exactly — don't break existing content
- Verify build passes with no deprecation warning

## Deliverables
- Report changes to content.config.ts
- Confirm test directory deleted
- Confirm build passes with no "Auto-generating collections" warning
